answer: In a risk market for garden fires, ember dispersal and glacier melt, weight reports by capital locked until voting closes. Validators read the escrow ledger and grant one unit of influence per locked token, counting each deposit once across all keys. Dividing 100 tokens among 100 accounts still yields 100 units; a new key cannot release the locked deposit. More influence requires locking more tokens for the same interval, sacrificing their use elsewhere. Wealth can still buy influence, and collateral does not verify a report's truth.
